target.title: fix(discord): sustained gateway bursts stop growing memory
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Discord Gateway commands above the 120-events-per-60-seconds connection limit were appended to an unbounded in-memory queue. Sustained presence or member-request traffic could therefore grow memory indefinitely while retaining increasingly stale work.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Gateway send limiter now retains at most one additional 120-event window. When that queue is saturated, it drops the oldest deferred command and keeps the newest command instead of throwing into presence/member callers. The limiter emits one structured warning per saturation episode and exposes the cumulative dropped-event count in its existing status snapshot.

This policy stays in the queue owner. Heartbeats, identify/resume, and voice-state updates remain critical sends and bypass the ordinary deferred queue. Reconnect cleanup remains unchanged.

The generic bounded-cache helpers were not reused because they own dedupe or insertion-ordered Map semantics rather than a serialized FIFO. The shared message queue helper is not a plugin SDK surface. LINE and Slack durable ingress spools retain events because their webhook/relay acknowledgement contracts require redelivery; Discord presence/member commands have no comparable durable-delivery contract, so keeping the newest bounded state is the better overload behavior.

Discord documents a limit of 120 Gateway events per connection every 60 seconds: https://docs.discord.com/developers/events/gateway#rate-limiting

## User Impact

Long-running Discord connections no longer accumulate an unbounded send backlog. During sustained overload, stale deferred presence/member commands are discarded without surfacing synchronous queue-full failures to ordinary callers, and operators receive a bounded warning signal.

## Evidence

Focused behavior proof:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/gateway-logging.test.ts extensions/discord/src/internal/gateway.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/auto-presence.test.ts extensions/discord/src/actions/runtime.presence.test.ts

Test Files  4 passed (4)
Tests       54 passed (54)
```

The owner-level overflow regression exhausts the live send window, queues 122 indexed presence commands, verifies the two oldest deferred commands are dropped, verifies the newest 120 flush in order, checks the cumulative drop count, and proves one warning is emitted for the continuous saturation episode.

Changed-surface proof delegated to Blacksmith Testbox and passed formatting, extension production/test typechecks, extension lint, plugin boundaries, dependency guards, and runtime import-cycle checks:

https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29669128543

Structured autoreview completed cleanly on the final rewrite with the focused proof running in parallel.

No config, environment variable, UI, protocol, SDK, dependency, storage, or migration surface changes.
